3. In Writ Petition No. 479 of 2007, the petitioner was appointed as a Flight Steward of Bangladesh Biman on 20-6-1978. By an order dated 2-1-1985, the petitioner was promoted to Junior Purser, Flight Service. By an order dated 11-11-1990, the petitioner was promoted as Purser. On 26-7-1978, the petitioner was confirmed as Chief Purser. Lastly, the petitioner was promoted to the post of Manager, Flight Service on 8-9-2005. Lastly, the petitioner was placed as Manager, Flight Service (Briefing) on 11-10-2005. The petitioner was born on 6-1-1957, that is, he has another 7 years left before his retirement in the ordinary course of his service. The petitioner received the impugned order dated 17-1-2007 (Annexure-A) retiring him from service. 

 5. In Writ Petition No. 5182 of 2007, the petitioner was appointed as a Flight Stewardess of Bangladesh Biman (at present Biman Bangladesh Airlines) (Biman) on 29-3-1974. Later, she was promoted to and confirmed as Junior Purser, Flight Service. Afterwards, the petitioner was promoted as Flight Purser and then as Chief Purser. Lastly, she was promoted as Manager and was confirmed on 25-7-2004. The petitioner was born on 15-4-1956, that is, she has another 6 years left before her retirement in the ordinary course of her service. However, the petitioner received the impugned order dated 25-4-2007 retiring her from service as is evident from Annexure-A.
